query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT country_id), COUNT(*) FROM League; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id=l.id WHERE m.country_id<>l.country_id
result: 11 distinct country_id across 11 leagues, so each league belongs to exactly one country; 0 matches whose country_id differs from their league's country_id.
validation_method: distinct-value count and join consistency check

query: SELECT DISTINCT season FROM Match ORDER BY season
validation_method: distinct value enumeration

query: SELECT id,date,season FROM Match LIMIT 3; SELECT SUM(country_id IS NULL),SUM(league_id IS NULL),SUM(home_team_goal IS NULL),SUM(away_team_goal IS NULL),SUM(date IS NULL),SUM(season IS NULL) FROM Match

query: SELECT l.name, COUNT(*), AVG(m.home_team_goal) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id=l.id JOIN Country c ON l.country_id=c.id WHERE c.name='Poland' AND m.season='2010/2011' GROUP BY 1
result: Poland Ekstraklasa: 240 matches and an average home team goal count of 1.50416666666667.

query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id=l.id WHERE l.name='Belgium Jupiler League' AND substr(m.date,1,7)='2009-04'

query: SELECT l.name, SUM(m.home_team_goal=m.away_team_goal) FROM Match m JOIN League l ON m.league_id=l.id WHERE m.season='2015/2016' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
result: France Ligue 1 = 108 drawn matches, England Premier League = 107, Italy Serie A = 95; the draw condition is equality of home and away goal counts.
validation_method: league-grouped draw counting
